player_prompt.intro:
Kei te tākaro koe i te Toure o Hanoi ki {num_disks} disk.
Kua whakawhiwhia koe ki te neke i ngā disk mai i te toure A ki te toure C.
I te mea e whakaneke ana koe i te disk, tuhi te toure puna me te toure whāinga (hei tauira, '[A C]').
Ko te whakaoho, ka taea anake te neke i te disk ki runga o te toure, ā, kāore e taea te whakapiri i te disk nui ki runga i te disk iti.
Ki ia whakawhitinga, tukua he neke kotahi.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kāore koe i whakautu ki te '[source] [target]' tika.
invalid_move.invalid_tower: I tohua e koe he pūtake, poaka rānei kāore i te tika.
invalid_move.empty_tower: I whakamātau koe ki te neke i tētahi kōpae mai i tētahi pourewa kau.
invalid_move.same_tower: I whakamātau koe ki te neke i tētahi kōpae ki taua pourewa.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: I whakamātau koe ki te whakanoho i tētahi kōpae nui ake ki runga i tētahi Kōpae iti.

game_action.moved: Kua nekehia e koe te kōpae {disk} mai i {source} ki {target}.

outcome.win: Ngā mihi nui, kua oti i a koe te whakaoti i te pāhā o Te Pourewa o Hanoi.
outcome.turn_limit: Kua tae te rohe huri. I tika koe ki {pct}% o nga kōpae i runga i Tower C.
